$sources: CFE Manual de Diseño de Obras Civiles, Diseño por Viento (2008): the regional speed VR of Mexico City (50-year return period, Group B) and the barometric factor G = 0.392 Ω / (273 + τ) of its altitude
source: CFE Viento (VR, G) and NTC-Sismo (the city's zones are the site classes I, II, IIIa-IIId of the seismic table). Other cities: a custom location with the CFE values (VR and G) and the site's spectrum parameters (seismic.designSpectrum.ductility.sites under Code Values).

sources.windSpeed: CFE Viento 2008: VR of Mexico City for a 50-year return period about 118 km/h (32.8 m/s; SAEngine reading, to be checked: VERIFY.md)
sources.pressureFactor: CFE Viento 2008 Sec 4.2.5: qz = 0.0048 G VD² [kgf/m², km/h] = 0.610 G VD² [Pa, m/s]; G = 0.392 Ω / (273 + τ) with Ω = 579 mmHg at 2240 m and τ = 16 °C: G = 0.785; × 0.610 / 0.613 (the program's constant) = 0.781
sources.zone: Z is not used by the zone spectra: the location's zone 1 takes Z = 1.0 (zoneCoefficients); the city's zone is the project's site class
